brass_lantern.name: Brass Lantern
brass_lantern.description: A battered brass lantern. It's seen better days, but still has some fuel left.

elvish_sword.name: Elvish Sword
elvish_sword.description: A beautiful elvish sword with strange etchings. It glows faintly with a pale blue light.

nasty_knife.name: Nasty Knife
nasty_knife.description: A nasty-looking knife. You consider your life choices.

rope.name: Rope
rope.description: A length of sturdy hemp rope. Useful for all sorts of adventuring mishaps.

jewel_encrusted_egg.name: Jewel-Encrusted Egg
jewel_encrusted_egg.description: A beautiful egg, covered in delicate jewels. Something rattles inside.

painting.name: Painting
painting.description: A painting of remarkable beauty, depicting a pastoral scene of impossible detail.

torch.name: Torch
torch.description: An ancient torch that burns with a steady, unwavering flame. It never seems to go out.

bag_of_coins.name: Bag of Coins
bag_of_coins.description: A leather bag filled with gold coins. They clink satisfyingly.

troll_axe.name: Bloody Axe
troll_axe.description: The troll's weapon. It's covered in... you don't want to think about what.

mailbox.name: Small Mailbox
mailbox.description: A small mailbox stands here, slightly askew. It has a tiny flag raised.

trophy_case.name: Trophy Case
trophy_case.description: A large glass trophy case, currently gathering dust. It yearns for treasures.

oriental_rug.name: Oriental Rug
oriental_rug.description: A richly woven oriental rug covers the floor. There's something odd about its shape — a lump, perhaps?

trap_door.name: Trap Door
trap_door.description: A wooden trap door, set into the floor. It looks like it leads down into darkness.

wrench.name: Wrench
wrench.description: A heavy wrench, perfect for loosening stubborn bolts.

platinum_bar.name: Platinum Bar
platinum_bar.description: A bar of pure platinum. Incredibly heavy, incredibly valuable.

guidebook.name: Dam Guidebook
guidebook.description: A guidebook titled 'Flood Control Dam #3: A Tourist's Guide'. It contains useful information about the dam's operation.

crystal_trident.name: Crystal Trident
crystal_trident.description: A magnificent trident carved from a single crystal. It catches the light beautifully.

pile_of_leaves.name: Pile of Leaves
pile_of_leaves.description: A pile of leaves that has accumulated in the clearing. Something might be hidden underneath.
